dispositions.topic_text: Required-test action coverage for A04-3 and A04-6 revision and no-change guarantees
Timestamp representation and monotonicity when revisions move within one clock tick
dispositions.reason: A04-3 sets last-changed to the action's instant ('now'), the one clock reading the action takes (A04, L16); it decides no strictly later value. Two changes read in one clock tick record equal instants, and the revision, which moves by exactly one each time, orders them. Requiring a strictly later instant would be a new rule the owner has not taken.
